name: SM Mall of Asia
slides: SM Mall of Asia at a glance
Nearly a million people on day one
SM reported about one million visitors on opening day in May 2006. President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo attended the inauguration.
The MOA Square expansion opened in 2021. Its IKEA covers 65,000 m², making it IKEA's largest store in the world.
The Philippines' first Olympic-sized ice skating rink sits on the mall's third level. It covers 1,800 m².
The mall stands on reclaimed land along Manila Bay. Next to it turns the MOA Eye, a 55-metre Ferris wheel with 36 air-conditioned gondolas.

caption:
The Metro Manila mall with the world's largest IKEA store 🇵🇭

SM Mall of Asia sits on reclaimed land by Manila Bay in Pasay. Nearly one million people came on opening day in 2006. Today it has 663 shops, an Olympic-size ice rink and an IKEA of 65,000 m².
